body: There's a section on our [Conditional Display](https://www.algolia.com/doc/guides/building-search-ui/going-further/conditional-display/js/) page that talks about [handling empty queries](https://www.algolia.com/doc/guides/building-search-ui/going-further/conditional-display/js/#handling-empty-queries). There are two workarounds for now. We are aware that those are not optimal though.
